settings.repere: Paragraphe · Well, first, estrogen and progesterone,
settings.text: Well, first, estrogen and progesterone, the two hormones that control many of your body’s functions, drop sharply and become wildly unpredictable, disrupting your body’s natural rhythms.

settings.text: It gets even worse when perimenopause hits, because that’s when your body becomes a stranger, with new issues appearing out of nowhere week after week. Leaving you feeling overwhelmed & desperate for answers.

settings.text: Sex might start to feel like a chore due to vaginal dryness.

settings.text: And it’s not just the dryness, it’s the feeling like you’re broken. Like you’re failing your partner. Like you’re not a “real” woman anymore.
